activities.name: Welcome Dinner — La Ereta
activities.address: Parque de La Ereta, s/n, Alicante
activities.description: Sponsored by ESRI. Mediterranean tasting-menu dinner at La Ereta, perched on Mount Benacantil below Santa Bárbara Castle with panoramic views over Alicante. Buses depart the hotel at 19:00 (dinner service from ~19:30), returning at 21:30.

activities.name: Gala Dinner — La Dársena
activities.address: Avda. Perfecto Palacio de la Fuente, 6, Muelle de Poniente (Centro de negocios Panoramis Life & Business), 03001 Alicante
activities.description: Sponsored by FLAI. Dinner at Dársena, known for authentic Alicantian rice dishes on the marina. Buses depart the hotel at 19:00 (dinner service from ~19:30), returning at 21:30.

activities.name: City Tour — Extended Networking
activities.description: Sponsored by Dielmo 3D. Extended networking city tour of Alicante, concluding back at the hotel around 13:00.
